name: Sidebar
summary: The side navigation of an app: groups of links with icons and counts, a header, a footer and a collapsed icon form.
useWhen: The main navigation of an app with more than five destinations, kept in view on every page
Destinations that fall into named groups (Workspace, Projects, Admin), some of which may fold away
Destinations that carry a count, such as unread messages or open tasks
Settings or admin areas with a list of sections down the side
avoidWhen: Three to five destinations on a phone layout
A narrow column of icons only, with no labels or groups
Switching between views of one page or one record
The top navigation of a marketing site with a brand and dropdown panels
Actions that change data, such as Save or Delete

label.description: The accessible name of the nav landmark: Main, Settings. Not drawn.

size.description: Row height from size.control: sm 28px, md 32px at default density. Compact makes them 24 and 28, comfortable 32 and 36.

collapsed.description: Controlled collapsed state: items show only their icons, labels stay as the accessible names.

defaultCollapsed.description: Collapsed at first render when uncontrolled.

onCollapsedChange.description: Called with the next collapsed state when the toggle is pressed.

collapsible.description: Renders the toggle, an IconButton with icon sidebar, at the inline end of the header. A header is added when none is given.

toggleLabels.description: The toggle's accessible names. Under an Arabic Theme the defaults are طي القائمة الجانبية and توسيع القائمة الجانبية.

SidebarGroup.label.description: The visible heading and the name of the group's list.

SidebarGroup.collapsible.description: The heading becomes a ghost Button that opens and closes the group (Radix Collapsible). The group then stamps data-state open or closed.

SidebarGroup.open.description: Controlled open state of a collapsible group.

SidebarGroup.defaultOpen.description: Open at first render when uncontrolled.

SidebarGroup.onOpenChange.description: Called with the next open state.

SidebarItem.href.description: Where the item goes. Removed while disabled.

SidebarItem.start.description: The leading icon, a system icon name or a node. Give every item one if the sidebar can collapse.

SidebarItem.count.description: A number after the label. Over 99 shows 99+; 0 draws nothing.

SidebarItem.countLabel.description: What the count means, read instead of the bare number: 12 unread.

SidebarItem.active.description: The current page: aria-current page, data-active, bold weight, a fill and a bar on the inline start edge.

SidebarItem.disabled.description: Removes the href, sets role link, aria-disabled and data-disabled, and stays in the tab order. With asChild the plain anchor renders instead of the router child, so the child's own click never runs.

SidebarItem.asChild.description: Renders the single child element, a router link, as the item.

children.description: SidebarHeader, SidebarGroups and a SidebarFooter. An item's children are its label.

a11y.role: navigation (nav with aria-label); each group is a list named by its heading; items are links
a11y.focus: Every item is a tab stop, disabled ones included. The ring is an inset 2px ring from color.focus.ring inside the row.

keys.Tab: Moves to the next item, group trigger or the toggle
keys.Enter: Follows the item, or opens and closes a group from its trigger
keys.Space: Opens and closes a group from its trigger, and presses the toggle

a11y.announce: The current item says current page. The toggle is a button named for its next action (Collapse sidebar, Expand sidebar), with no aria-expanded: every link stays in place, only drawn smaller. A group trigger has aria-expanded. A count with countLabel reads as Inbox 12 unread.

native.accessibilityRole: link (each item; the container has no role)

notes: The current page is shown by aria-current, a bold weight, a fill and an edge bar, never by color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).

Collapsed items keep the label in the DOM, visually hidden, so it stays the accessible name. Tooltip (1.6.6) is not built yet: once it is, each collapsed item gets a Tooltip with its label (marked in SidebarItem).

The border and the active bar are on logical sides, so the sidebar's edge flips in RTL; the sidebar icon of the toggle mirrors. A sidebar placed at the inline end swaps --_sidebar-border-start-color and --_sidebar-border-end-color.
Group headings and counts go one font step up in Arabic, like the item labels.
A collapsed sidebar holds collapsible groups open and hides their trigger; the group stays mounted, so focus inside it is kept.
No native title attribute. Hints come from Tooltip.

en.label: Nouns in sentence case: Inbox, Billing, Team members. One or two words.
en.group: A short noun for the group heading: Workspace, Projects.
en.count: A plain number. Pass countLabel when the number alone does not say what it counts.
en.toggle: Verb plus noun: Collapse sidebar, Expand sidebar.

ar.label: Noun form, no diacritics: الوارد، الفواتير، أعضاء الفريق.
ar.group: A short noun: مساحة العمل، المشاريع.
ar.toggle: Noun form: طي القائمة الجانبية، توسيع القائمة الجانبية.

react.behavior: hand built nav, radix:Collapsible for groups, radix:Slot for asChild
react.note: fade-rise: an opened group's list fades in and rises one step; closing is instant. Reduced motion: none. The width never animates, so collapse is instant.

angular.behavior: nav[dsSidebar], cdk:accordion or a disclosure directive for groups

native.note: On phones the sidebar is a drawer; the collapsed form applies to tablets.

styles.studio: Flat surface with a hairline on the inline end edge. The active item takes an overlay fill, bright text, bold weight and a white bar.
styles.desk: The same layout. The active bar takes the yellow of color.primary.on-surface.
styles.neutral: Takes the tokens of the Neutral style, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: The current page shown only by a different text color
mistakes.right: active, which adds aria-current, weight, a fill and an edge bar

mistakes.wrong: Items with no icon in a sidebar that can collapse
mistakes.right: start on every item, so the collapsed column still shows each destination

mistakes.wrong: A Sidebar of icon buttons with no labels
Hiding the label with display none when collapsed
mistakes.right: Collapsed keeps the label as the accessible name

mistakes.wrong: Buttons that save or delete inside the item list
mistakes.right: Items only navigate; actions go in the header or footer as Buttons
